body.statement:
Let \(V\) and \(Y\) be centered Gaussian vectors in \(\mathbb R^p\), assume the coordinate variances of \(Y\) are bounded above and away from zero, and put \(\Delta_0=\max_{j,\ell}|\operatorname{Cov}(V_j,V_\ell)-\operatorname{Cov}(Y_j,Y_\ell)|\).  Lemma 3.1 gives
\[
 \sup_z\left|P\{\max_jV_j\le z\}-P\{\max_jY_j\le z\}\right|
 \le C\Delta_0^{1/3}\{1\vee\log(p/\Delta_0)\}^{2/3},
\]
without a positive-minimum-eigenvalue requirement.

attestation.note: Verified directly against the Lemma 3.1 environment in the arXiv TeX source.

body.justification: This converts the deterministic maximum covariance error into a conditional Gaussian distribution error.
body.gap: The application must still prove the covariance discrepancy for the frozen score construction.
body.consumer: It supplies the covariance-comparison term in thm:uniform-multiplier-band.
